about: The Workbench icons of the Flare drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's distribution/flare_logo_icon.png at 48x48. Flare-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Flare.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Flare.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence and credits files; Folder.info for mods and its drawers.
